notes: Only files under public/assets are listed in "files". All other art (facade/shop atlases, ground/roof noise, vehicles, hero car, markers, sky, vapour sprites) is original procedural content generated in code at runtime; no external model, texture or image bytes are used for them.
Poly Haven assets are CC0; credit is given without implying endorsement.
No Tesla logos or marks are used. The hero car is an original design; "Metro Express" is an original placeholder delivery branding drawn in code.
Shopfront sign bands are blank colour blocks; real names appear only where a building carries an OSM name (rendered through createSignTexture).

v2: storefront signboards render the REAL listing name (Overture Places, CDLA-Permissive-2.0) as text only, on a per-chunk canvas atlas; no brand logos or trademarks are drawn. Category fixtures (crates, mannequins, ATM box, tyres, pipes) and the shop-front atlas are original procedural content.
